name: Guild Street
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts, and continues to the north and south. The bulk
desc3: of the Adventurer's Guild lies to the south and east, its second story
desc4: peeking up over the tops of the smaller buildings like a curious
desc5: child. To the west, a squat stone building stands. It has a large
desc6: stone door with the words "Thuluk's Axes" carved in it in an angular
desc7: script. You can hear the harsh sound of clanging steel from inside.
